verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's own docs describe reserved instances that give discounts of up to 50% for pre-paying GPU time, and say any on-demand instance can be converted to a reserved one at any time to get a lower hourly rate. That directly delivers locking in committed-use discounts for sustained capacity. Missing for 10: documented commitment terms or durations, clarity on whether the reservation guarantees capacity on a given host, details of CLI/API support for reservations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
